    Galleon - Class in iscteiul.ista.battleship
    A galleon ("Galeao"): the largest ship of the game, occupying five positions arranged in a "T" shape (a bar of three positions plus a stem of two positions starting at the middle of the bar).
    Galleon(Compass, IPosition) - Constructor for class iscteiul.ista.battleship.Galleon
    Creates a galleon at the given position and with the given bearing.
